name: twoplayergames
description: 并列的双人在线小游戏。共享基础设施在 platform/*,玩法各自独立。

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bw-s,bw-c,fm-s,fm-c,a2f-s,a2f-c,tp-s,tp-c -c blue,cyan,green,greenBright,yellow,yellowBright,magenta,magentaBright "npm run dev -w @bw/server" "npm run dev -w @bw/client" "npm run dev -w @fm/server" "npm run dev -w @fm/client" "npm run dev -w @add-to-fifty/server" "npm run dev -w @add-to-fifty/client" "npm run dev -w @texas-poker/server" "npm run dev -w @texas-poker/client"
